main_text.p: res in Westergoâ omnia rursum miscue-runt. Inter quos Smalingani, ut quietos se Fœdus Smalin-ganum ampliatū. ac tutos sisterent, anno M. cccc.LXXXVI I. fœdus suum, quod cum civitate Groningana habebant, ampliatum auctumque renovarunt. Imprimis addidêre jam de prætore ac judicibus arbitrio Groningensium eligendis quotannis, deque compellendis iisdem ad faciendum officium per Hovetmannos, & de prætorio Hovetmannorum imperio in eum agrum: de arce, si res posceret, illic extruenda, & præfecto[?] Groningano ei imponendo, de ferendis mutuo auxiliis contra contumaces, & domesticos peregrinosque hostes, ex Upsterano fœdere ad verbum descripta. Quadriennio pòst, anno nimirum M. cccc. xc I. cum Reip. mala crebrescerent, & validiora indies fierent, nil penè cuiquam tuti esset factionum exitialium causa, tandem Doccumani cum Dongeranis, & maxima O-stergoæ parte supplices facti GroninganFœdus O-stergoû omnium maximè inclytum.nis sunt, & humillimis æque ac pertinacissimis precibus vix demum ab iis impetrarunt, ut fœdus secum percuterent. page.notes: The text runs over the lower margin and the hyphenated word "Groningan-nis" breaks across the column. Printing and reading doubts: a dot stands before "de" in the first line of the italic passage and is probably a speck. "cccc.LXXXVI I." is printed with a space and may be meant as LXXXVII. "præfecto" is uncertain because the letters are blurred. "XV I II" is printed with spaces and may be meant as XVIII. The Quadriennio line reads "xc I." as printed. The digitiser's watermark at the lower right is left out.
